{{Top}}
[[File:Information_broker.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] information broker]]
{{Quote|An information broker owed me a favor, and I called it in.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="rd">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
'''Information brokers''', also known as '''informants''', were private consultants, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], or [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] who provided information and intelligence for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], they were sometimes referred to as [[code dealer]]s, '''infochants''', or '''sluicers'''.

==Information brokers in the galaxy==
[[File:Information_broker_TotG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] information broker]]
[[Kyle Katarn]] came to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to receive information about the death of [[Morgan Katarn|his father]] from the information broker droid [[8t88]], although the droid ended up [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|betraying]] him. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] attempted to receive information from an information broker on Nar Shaddaa concerning the [[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]] project, [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga the Hutt]] and [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] mysterious [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]]. The [[Assembler]] known as [[Balancesheet]] was an infochant, as well as his predecessor and creator, [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. [[Talon Karrde]] was a well-known information broker who assisted the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
